heading: Liji 28 · Zhong Yong 中庸 · The State Of Equilibrium And Harmony · Zhong Yong I.1 … Zhong Yong I.35

items.text: Serve your father as you would require your son to serve you.
items.quote: To serve my father as I would require my son to serve me

items.text: Serve your elder brother as you would require a younger brother to serve you.
items.quote: to serve my elder brother as I would require a younger brother to serve me

work: The State Of Equilibrium And Harmony

work: The State Of Equilibrium And Harmony

items.text: Be in submissive accord with your parents, for without this you will not be trusted even by your friends.
items.quote: if he be not in submissive accord with his parents, he will not be believed in by his friends.

work: The State Of Equilibrium And Harmony
heading: Liji 28 · Zhong Yong 中庸 · The State Of Equilibrium And Harmony · Zhong Yong I.59 … Zhong Yong II.15

items.text: Offer sacrifices to your forefathers in the ancestral temple.
items.quote: by those of the ancestral temple they sacrificed to their forefathers
items.conflict: Ancestral sacrifice is worship of the dead, forbidden by the first commandment.

items.quote: he should not, neglect to serve his parents
the greatest exercise of it is in the love of relatives

items.text: Give your relatives positions of honor and generous support, and sympathize with them in their likes and dislikes.
items.quote: Giving his relatives places of honour, and large emolument, and entering into sympathy with them

work: The State Of Equilibrium And Harmony
heading: Liji 28 · Zhong Yong 中庸 · The State Of Equilibrium And Harmony · Zhong Yong I.36 … Zhong Yong I.58

items.text: In a high position, do not insult or oppress those below you.
items.quote: In a high situation, he does not insult or oppress those who are below him

items.text: In a low position, do not cling to or depend on those above you; rectify yourself and seek nothing from them.
items.quote: in a low situation, he does not cling to or depend on those who are above him.

items.text: Cherish accord with your brothers above even wife and children; their harmony brings lasting joy.
items.quote: But brothers more than they Can satisfy the heart. 'Tis their accord does peace afford

items.text: Serve your departed ancestors as you served them in life: repair and beautify their temple, set forth their vessels and dresses, and present offerings of the seasons.
items.quote: they repaired and beautified the temple-halls of their ancestors, set forth their ancestral vessels, displayed their dresses, and presented the offerings of the several seasons.
items.conflict: Exodus 20:3-5 forbids worship of anyone but God; ancestors are not divine.

items.text: Mourn for father and mother with the same mourning, three years, making no distinction between noble and mean.
items.quote: In the mourning, for a father or mother no difference was made between the noble and the mean;--it was one and the same for all.

items.text: At ancestral ceremonies, inferiors present the cup to superiors, giving even the lowest a part to do.
items.quote: in the ceremony of general pledging, the inferiors presented the cup to the superiors
